nature: post hoc descriptive reanalysis of saved outputs; not preregistered before original holdout
prohibition: No simulation, cloud use, hyperparameter change, or new main significance test

probability.units: 16 image blocks; each block averages two task seeds within rho x load, then six conditions
probability.sla_scale: per_run fractions multiplied by 100, paired differences in percentage points
probability.intervals: marginal 95% percentile intervals over image blocks; descriptive, no p values
probability.caveat: Panel evaluation times differ by horizon: 24=[2,6,12,24],120 adds[60,120],600 adds[300,600]. Absolute horizon differences are not a controlled learning effect.

heterogeneity.conditions: rho=0,.25,.5,.75,1 x balanced/late_sparse; 20 images x 5 task seeds x 1800 prediction-before-update events each
heterogeneity.local_weight: heterogeneity_local_weight = H/(H+0.5*v) only when n_local>0 and H>0, else 0
heterogeneity.separations: n_local=0; n_local>0 and H=0; n_local>0 and H>0; insufficient observed group contexts also reported
heterogeneity.means: stream event means, then five seeds per image, then twenty images equally; equal stream lengths make pooled mean identical
heterogeneity.quantiles: pooled empirical quantiles of prediction-before-update events in each rho x flow; separate all-event and local-history-only denominators
heterogeneity.inference: none; prediction events are not independent inferential units
